name: Celebration
hint: Press it once. The confetti uses the current theme's colours.
description: Confetti for a real milestone, used once. Coloured from the live theme, it bursts from the button that earned it and the paper flutters as it falls; reduced motion swaps it for a calm halo.
intents: confetti when a goal is reached
usage: Reserve for genuine firsts (first publish, first sale, plan upgraded). Never on routine saves. Pass `label`, `doneLabel`, `message`, `detail` and `onCelebrate`; blank labels show "Continue" / "Done" and no message. If `onCelebrate` returns a promise (the publish itself), the button shows a spinner and cannot be pressed again; it celebrates when the promise resolves and returns to rest with no confetti if it rejects. If your work is tracked elsewhere, set `busy`. The done state is uncontrolled (`defaultDone`) or controlled (`done` + `onDoneChange`); setting `done` yourself settles the button without confetti, and setting it back to false makes it pressable again. Also exported: burst(el, { x, y, count, spread, power, gravity, shapes, ignoreReducedMotion }) to fire from anywhere without mounting the component: `el` is any element inside your Theme (the colours are read from it), x and y are viewport pixels, count defaults to 140. It draws on its own fixed canvas and removes it when the pieces have fallen, and returns a function that stops it early. Under prefers-reduced-motion it draws nothing unless ignoreReducedMotion is true.

exports.description: burst(el, { x, y, count, spread, power, gravity, shapes, ignoreReducedMotion }): fire confetti from a point without mounting the component. Returns a stop function. Draws nothing under prefers-reduced-motion unless ignoreReducedMotion is true.

dataProps.description: () => void | Promise. Called when the button is pressed (not while busy, disabled, or done with `once`). Return a promise to celebrate only when it resolves; a rejection returns the button to rest with no confetti (show your own error).
Button text before celebrating. Blank shows "Continue" (the sample "Publish site" with `demo`).
Button text after celebrating. Blank shows "Done" (the sample "Published" with `demo`).
Bold line under the button once done, announced politely. Blank shows nothing.
Smaller line under the message once done. Blank shows nothing.
Controlled done state. Pair with onDoneChange. Setting it does not fire confetti.
Done state on mount when uncontrolled (a milestone already celebrated).
(done) => void when the button celebrates (true) or the demo reset link is used (false).
Caller-owned busy state: a spinner replaces the sparkle, aria-busy is set and presses are ignored.
Native disabled on the button: not focusable or pressable, dimmed.
Sample copy ("Publish site", "Published", "You're live", a detail line) where yours is blank, plus a "Reset demo" link once done. For the gallery; off by default.
Other attributes (id, aria-*, data-*, event handlers) go to the button; className and style go to the root.
The button: focus it, or measure it (burst() can fire from it).
